description: This Java class 'SimpleMapProcessor' is part of the 'org.apache.ofbiz.minilang' package and implements a mini language for processing simple maps using XML configurations and caching mechanisms.

classes.name: SimpleMapProcessor
classes.description: A utility class for processing XML-defined map processors with caching and execution methods.

methods.name: getAllProcessors
methods.description: Reads an XML document from a URL and constructs a map of processor names to MapProcessor instances.

methods.name: getProcessors
methods.description: Retrieves or loads a map of processors based on an XML resource string, class loader, and name.

methods.name: getProcessors
methods.description: Retrieves or loads a map of processors based on an XML URL and name.

methods.name: runSimpleMapProcessor
methods.description: Executes a named map processor defined in an XML resource, with input and output maps, messages, and locale.

methods.name: runSimpleMapProcessor
methods.description: Executes a named map processor from an XML URL, with input and output maps, messages, locale, and class loader.
